title: Pixel Studio playground payload
description: The JSON in the playground's #spec=. Usually a change to the character picked with ?c= (a variant: list only what differs). With its own `figure` or `size` and no `extends` it is a whole character instead. Guide: ../docs/playground.md. Full format: ../docs/SPEC.md (Materials, Parts, Shapes, Variants, Style, Skins).

extends.description: Base character file, e.g. "goose-root.json". Set automatically from ?c= when absent (unless this is a whole character).

materials.description: Merged into the base per material and per field: {"color": ...} keeps the base texture. null removes a material. A material no shape uses is dropped. The playground's options().materials lists the current ones.

materialMap.description: Re-point every shape drawn in one material to another: {"plumage": "hoodie"}.

parts.description: Each entry with an existing id patches that part (fields replace; `shapes` replaces the list; `addShapes` appends). {"id": ..., "remove": true} deletes the part and its children. A new id adds a part (give it `parent`, `pivot`, `z`, `shapes`). options().parts lists the ids.

skins.description: Named looks every animation shares; pick one with ?skin=. Each is a patch with only parts, materials, materialMap and style.

animations.description: null removes an animation; an existing one merges (tracks merge per part and property, null removes); a new name adds one. Format: ../docs/SPEC.md#animations.

views.description: Front/back views: {"front": {"parts": [...part patches, ids without the "front." prefix]}, "back": {...}}. See ../docs/figures.md.

figure.description: Whole characters only: the skeleton to build on, e.g. "goose". See ../docs/SPEC.md#figures-start-from-a-skeleton-that-already-moves-well.

size.description: Whole characters only: canvas size in units, usually [100, 100].

ground.description: y of the foot line in units.

states.description: State machine for <pixel-sprite>; not used by the playground.

color.description: Base colour (required for a new material). The engine builds a hue-shifted ramp around it; pick mid-value, fairly saturated colours.

texture.description: Shown at detail 2+ only (res ≥ 21 px or ?lod=2/3). null removes the base texture.

shine.description: Specular highlight: metal, glass, slime, eyes.

flat.description: No lighting: always the exact colour (eyes, emissive bits).

outline.description: false skips outlines and inner lines next to this material (glints, glows, blush).

tones.description: Force the ramp length regardless of detail level.

style.description: Rendering style; each key overrides the detail preset at every detail level. Merged into the base per key.

outline.description: Silhouette outline; selective is tinted by the neighbouring material.

light.description: Light direction in degrees: 0 from above, -45 top-left (default), 90 from the right.

ambient.description: Lifts everything toward the base tone (default 0.15).

innerLines.description: Dark line where a front part overlaps a back part.

contactShadow.description: 1-px shadow cast by front parts onto back parts.

remove.description: Delete this part and its children.

bone.description: Characters built on a figure: attach this new part to that bone (parent = the bone, pivot = its joint, z = its z + 0.5). See ../docs/figures.md.

pivot.description: Point it rotates and scales around.

z.description: Draw order; higher is in front.

shade.description: Brightness offset, e.g. -0.35 for the far wing or leg.

show.description: 0 hides the part at rest (animations can show it).

shape.description: Coordinates in canvas units (0..100 for the examples) at rest. circle: cx cy r · ellipse: cx cy rx ry (+rot) · rect: x y w h (+r corner radius, rot) · capsule: x1 y1 x2 y2 r (+r2 tapered end) · polygon: points (+r rounding).

op.description: Erase what earlier shapes of the same part drew.
